title: Correct turns for 6V coil
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates n2 using the transformer turns ratio, yielding n2 = 30 turns.

title: Correct turns for 110V coil
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates n3 using the transformer turns ratio, yielding n3 = 50 turns.

title: Power conservation principle
description: Important: Student states or applies the ideal transformer principle that input power equals total output power.

title: Total output power calculation
description: Important: Student correctly sums the rated powers of the two appliances to find the total output power (80 W).

title: Primary current calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the primary input current using I1 = (P2+P3)/U1, yielding 0.36 A.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student shows consistent use of units (V, W, A) throughout the calculation.

title: Incorrect turns ratio application
description: Pitfall: Student inverts the turns ratio (e.g., uses n1/n2 = U1/U2), leading to incorrect n2 or n3.

title: Power sum error
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly adds powers (e.g., uses P2*P3) or uses currents before finding powers.
